subject.title: refactor(memory): drop redundant agent-id scoping from qmd collection names

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally replace the shipped agent-suffixed QMD collection identifiers with unscoped identifiers local to each agent index?
rationale: The implementation is sound under the current per-agent index invariant, but it changes observable identifiers shipped since the 2026.4 release line and constrains future shared-index topology; source inspection cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Adopt unscoped names
options.body: Accept collection identifiers as agent-index-local and land the guarded one-way rebuild migration.

options.title: Keep scoped identifiers
options.body: Preserve existing qmd:// URIs and CLI filters if identifier stability or future shared indexes outweigh removing the redundant suffix.

recommendation.title: Adopt unscoped names
recommendation.body: Accept collection identifiers as agent-index-local and land the guarded one-way rebuild migration.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current scoped namespace and migration during the memory plugin and host refactors, making him the strongest available owner for the compatibility decision.
